name: GhostMask
description: Review, redact and export browser content locally. Approve individual form insertions without exposing original values.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:11434 http://127.0.0.1:1234; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'
